target.frame: 4:3 archival image composed for a 16:9 master

models.notes: Use SDXL plus the face-cropped IP-Adapter Plus variant for the Bimal anchor. The adapter encourages likeness; it is not an exact identity guarantee. Review every output.

approval_rule: Print this complete queue first. Require typed approval per batch. Maximum three image outputs per batch. Do not automatically run any batch.

batches.review_checkpoint: Review the face, age, hair, goatee, and shirt against the existing Bimal references. Save a selected anchor manually before B02.
Review all repaired plates for text, icon/watermark artifacts, face continuity, and 4:3 composition. Keep outputs as candidates until manually selected.

jobs.prompt: [REFERENCE IMAGE: references/bimal_face_reference_v01.jpg, using the cropped face as the identity reference] Create a photorealistic character anchor portrait of the same fictional Bengali man. Keep his facial proportions, medium-brown skin tone, short slightly wavy black hair, close goatee, and tired observant brown eyes recognizably consistent with the reference; make him late 20s to early 30s, not middle-aged. Change only the framing into a quiet waist-up three-quarter portrait with relaxed shoulders and both hands visible. Wardrobe: plain charcoal heavy-metal T-shirt with no band name, lettering, or logo, and dark half-pants. Setting: lived-in 1990s Bengali bedroom with limewash, aged teak, and one candle far behind him. Camera: eye-level 50 mm portrait, natural perspective, face sharply focused. Lighting: restrained candle key with soft warm edge light and deep but readable shadows. Finish: realistic skin texture, subtle 1990s film grain and very light CRT transfer texture, not glossy beauty lighting. Composition: centered subject with head and hands inside safe margins. Aspect ratio 4:3. No other people, no supernatural features, no text, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
jobs.negative_prompt: different face, older man, clean-shaven, full beard, long hair, heroic pose, fashion portrait, plastic skin, over-smoothed face, extra fingers, deformed hands, duplicate person, readable text, letters, brand logo, watermark, signature, extra eyes, gore
